svg.title: Matrix product and its derived gradients
svg.desc: A 2-by-3 matrix lhs times a 3-by-2 matrix rhs yields a 2-by-2 output. The compiler derives the gradients of both operands as two further matrix products with the cotangent.
svg.text: C = A·B, gradients from the same operation
each entry output[i, j] = Σ_k lhs[i, k] · rhs[k, j] — row i of lhs dotted with column j of rhs
